articles.headline: Regeneron's Phase 3 melanoma trial fails, wiping out billions in market value
articles.summary: Regeneron's fianlimab plus Libtayo combination failed to meet statistical significance versus Keytruda in a Phase 3 melanoma trial, despite showing numerical improvement (11.5 vs 6.4 months progression-free survival). The failure adds to mounting setbacks for LAG-3 inhibitor drug class and raises broader questions about Regeneron's pipeline strategy as the company faces pressure from Eylea biosimilars and slower-than-expected uptake of high-dose Eylea.
articles.why_it_matters: Validates investor concerns about next-generation immunotherapy targets beyond PD-1 inhibitors and highlights pipeline execution risks at a major biotech facing franchise headwinds, with analysts now questioning whether Regeneron needs external business development to sustain growth.

articles.headline: MBI Deep Dives: The Honeymoon Phase of Capacity
articles.summary: Analysis of CoreWeave and Nebius Q1 2026 earnings reveals massive backlog growth ($100B for CoreWeave, up from $25.9B) and complex capacity allocation deals, including Nebius's innovative $27B Meta agreement that functions as a capacity put option. The piece examines whether neocloud providers represent durable alternatives to hyperscalers or temporary solutions in the current supply-constrained AI compute market.
articles.why_it_matters: Provides detailed financial intelligence on the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure market dynamics, capacity economics, and competitive positioning between neoclouds and hyperscalers that directly impacts investment decisions in this critical sector.
